reviewScope: Recovery execution machinery only: exact historical continuation, restart durability, recovered evidence provenance, publication replay, and execution authorization. This is not a Gate-H scientific verdict and does not change H-v2 HOLD standing.
claimUnderReview: A reviewed recovery run can continue the failed H-v2 developmental attempt without regenerating completed development, without replaying successful historical provider calls, and without allowing the resulting world to replace the frozen H-v2 HOLD or enter G5/G6 evidence.
notClaimed: The recovery world is a replacement #39 cohort.
The recovery world may enter frozen G5/G6 diagnostics.
Provider execution is authorized by this review artifact.
propertiesThatHold: The frozen recovery binding remains a zero-provider-call boundary.
The exact first unfinished developmental operation is slot 4 episode 3 record retry #2.
Completed slot 1-3 generation artifacts are blob-bound and are not regenerated.
Slot 5 is demonstrated to have zero historical model attempts.
New successful model invocations are durably journaled and replayed by exact request witness on restart.
Publication uses the existing Genesis/#37/#38 authority and verifies Thread integrity after publication.
A separate execution-authorization witness is required; the historical recovery binding is not mutated to authorize calls.
Authorization must bind a reviewed implementation commit and runtime rejects any later repository diff outside the review and authorization witness paths.

findings.finding: The reconstructed slot-4 generation artifact under-represented historical cognition provenance: preserved episodes 1-2 had empty call lists and episode 3 exposed only continuation calls although six successful source responses existed.
findings.requiredResolution: Carry all six frozen successful historical responses and the historical repair/retry witnesses explicitly into recovery state and the reconstructed generation evidence without treating them as new recovery calls.
findings.currentResolution: Recovery state verifies all six successful historical responses and three historical repair/retry witnesses. The production orchestrator carries those calls into the preserved Pass-A entries, separates historical and recovery calls for episode 3, initializes the recovered repair-witness trail from the frozen source, and records historicalSuccessfulCalls explicitly. The user locally verified the active suite and validation green at 238053a965345673327bf3b1cadd07e4244a7d58.

findings.finding: Recovered-world publication did not persist Genesis generation-attempt witnesses for Pass-A repairs/retries or Pass-B repair calls, although the original H runner did.
findings.requiredResolution: Persist generation-attempt witnesses idempotently for preserved and newly generated Threads before birth publication, including the recovered historical repair trail.
findings.currentResolution: Recovery publication uses the existing GenesisStore.recordGenerationAttempt authority with the same deterministic attempt-id and Pass-A/Pass-B rules as the original H runner, before birth publication for every preserved or recovered generation. The user locally verified the active suite and validation green at 238053a965345673327bf3b1cadd07e4244a7d58.

findings.finding: Underlying historical-continuation and durable-invocation mechanisms were tested, but the full recovery orchestrator composition had not been exercised with a deterministic fake provider through restart/publication behavior.
findings.requiredResolution: Add a no-real-provider execution test or equivalent mechanically load-bearing composition test proving exact first-call behavior, durable replay after restart, slot ordering, and publication idempotence without creating a production authorization bypass.
findings.currentResolution: The production orchestrator delegates its high-level sequence to genesis-h2-recovery-sequencer.mjs. Its deterministic test uses the real Birth Center durable adapter, commits the exact first recovery request, simulates a crash, proves restart replay without a second provider invocation, proves slot 5 cannot precede completed/persisted slot 4, and proves publication replay is idempotent on a subsequent full pass. The user locally verified the active suite and validation green at 238053a965345673327bf3b1cadd07e4244a7d58.

findings.finding: Binding only the top-level orchestrator blob would not detect a later change in a delegated execution dependency such as the recovery sequencer.
findings.requiredResolution: The authorization witness must bind the final reviewed implementation head. Runtime authorization must require that head to be an ancestor of current HEAD and reject every post-review changed path except the execution-review and execution-authorization witness files. The top-level orchestrator blob and recovery-binding digest remain independently bound as defense in depth.
findings.currentResolution: The orchestrator now enforces a reviewedImplementationHead freeze using git merge-base and git diff, with only the review and authorization witness paths allowed after that head. A focused test pins the allowed-path boundary. Candidate final reviewed implementation head is 12c06df49aea5902d387718a9ea115eb87ab764a; no authorization witness may be created until that candidate is locally green.

findings.finding: Orchestrator preflight output previously printed authorization as absent and said no provider call was authorized even after a future valid authorization witness existed.
findings.requiredResolution: Make preflight wording reflect authorization presence while continuing to state that preflight itself makes zero provider calls.
findings.currentResolution: Preflight validates any present authorization against the current committed orchestrator blob and recovery binding, reports absent versus present-and-blob-bound accurately, and distinguishes zero-call preflight from authorization of the reviewed --execute path. The user locally verified this behavior at 238053a965345673327bf3b1cadd07e4244a7d58.

authorization.clearCondition: Local active suite and validation green at candidate final reviewed implementation head 12c06df49aea5902d387718a9ea115eb87ab764a, zero-call recovery/orchestrator preflights green, then promote review status to CLEAR_FOR_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION and create the separate witness bound to that exact head, orchestrator blob, recovery-binding digest, first provider operation, and non-evidentiary standing.
